testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/plp/verify-plp-sorting-and-grid-view-and-category-descriptions.spec.ts > PLP - Verify PLP Sorting, Grid View, and Category Descriptions > verify plp sorting and grid view and category descriptions

scenario.summary: Guest opens the Plumbing PLP at page size 64, checks the first product under the default sort, switches to Highest Rating, Name A-Z and Name Z-A (first product name/SKU for A-Z and Z-A, same list length as default), toggles list and grid view and checks the category short and long descriptions. Read-only.
steps: Open Plumbing via Departments (gotoCategory('linkPlumbing')) as a guest; set page size 64.
Default sort: check the first product name.
Sort 1 (Highest Rating): list length equals the default list (first/last only logged).
Sort 5 (Name A-Z): check hdgProductName474 name and divProductSKUContainer474 SKU; same length.
Sort 6 (Name Z-A): check hdgProductName466 name; same length.
Switch to list view and back to grid view.
Check the category short and long description (<pre> blocks).
assertions: First product under the default sort is the recorded one.
Name A-Z first product is the recorded name and SKU; Name Z-A first product is the recorded name.
Each sorted list has the same length as the default list.
Category short description 'This is a short description.' and long description 'This is a long description.'.
evidence: Title 'verify plp sorting and grid view and category descriptions' and the six step labels match the flow; guest storageState; no data file; no linked AIO cases.
Profile (atstage 2026-11-01): every value is NO_RULE (profiled false).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store every migrated webstore spec runs on; not named in the scan.

CATEGORY_WITH_PRODUCTS (pending) now covers the category: need category {store, topLevel true (opened from Departments through gotoCategory), minProducts 2, maxProducts 64 (one page at size 64), withDescriptions true}; the short and long descriptions -> category.shortDescription / category.longDescription (if stored with markup, the spec compares the text content). The category link id linkPlumbing (config) is built from category.name.

CATEGORY_LISTING_SORT_ANCHORS (pending) now covers the Name sorts: need listing {store, categoryId @category.categoryId}; the Name A-Z first name and SKU -> listing.firstNameAscName / listing.firstNameAscSku, the Name Z-A first name -> listing.firstNameDescName; the test ids hdgProductName474 / divProductSKUContainer474 and hdgProductName466 (config) are built from listing.firstNameAscProductId and listing.firstNameDescProductId.

Not covered: the first product under the default sort ('Mountain Plumbing 4 Inch Round ...') stays expected-output: the default and Highest Rating orders come from the search index with no tie-break, so no key can produce them (Highest Rating is only checked by list length). The spec notes atstage drift for these values.
Sort option values 1 / 5 / 6, page size 64 and the category link id are test settings: config.
Data in code: every value is a literal in the spec: product ids 474/466 in test ids, the product names and SKU, linkPlumbing and the description texts.
migrate: no data file (no loadData), the default-sort first name cannot come from a key, and product ids are in the spec code.
